newsitem.title: UK: UK government welcomes OFT pensions report.
newsitem.headline: UK government welcomes OFT pensions report.

text.p: The Labour government on Tuesday welcomed a report from Britain's Office of Fair Trading (OFT) which criticised existing pension products.
Pensions minister John Denham said the report, which called on the government to incorporate a new, flexible pension product - the designated personal pension - would be studied with great interest.

"The aims which lie behind the designated personal pension proposal reflect the government's belief that a new framework for value for money, flexible and secure second pensions should be developed," said Denham.

"We are committed to a wide-ranging pensions review, details of which will be announced shortly. Security in retirement is vital for today's and tomorrow's pensioners. This report will provide a valuable input to this comprehensive review particularly in terms of consumer interest."
